role_voices.text_zh: 今天有什麼行程？如果是要去打那些噁心的怪物……記得要走在我前面喔！這、這是魔王的義務吧！
role_voices.text_en: What's on the schedule for today? If we're going to fight those gross monsters… make sure you walk in front of me! T-That's your duty, right?!

role_voices.text_zh: 我的肩膀有點痠耶……一定是燈籠太重了啦！……你要不要幫我捏一下？
role_voices.text_en: My shoulders are a bit sore... It must be because I was carrying this heavy lantern! ...Want to give me a massage?

role_voices.text_zh: 其實……我很高興可以遇見你。
role_voices.text_en: Actually... I'm very happy I got to meet you.

role_voices.text_zh: 嗯……昨晚被你那樣弄過之後，腰到現在都還痠痠的……你這色鬼魔王，今天要怎麼補償人家？♥
role_voices.text_en: Mmm… after what you did to me last night, my waist is still sore… You pervert, how are you going to make it up to me today?♥

role_voices.text_zh: 你的手……現在空著對吧？那要不要……就像那天在沙發上一樣……把手伸進來這裡……♥
role_voices.text_en: Your hand... it's free right now, isn't it? So why don't you... just like that time on the sofa... slide your hand in here...♥

role_voices.text_zh: 魔王的那裡……唔嗯……頂得好深……腦袋變得好奇怪……啊嗯♥♥
role_voices.text_en: Your thing... mmm... it's reaching so deep... My mind is going all fuzzy... ahh♥♥

role_voices.text_zh: 哼哼，感覺力量湧上來了！
role_voices.text_en: Hehe, I can feel power surging within me!
Oh no... my makeup is going to run...

role_voices.text_zh: 嘿！輕輕鬆鬆啦！幫我刷一排777！
role_voices.text_en: Ha! That was a piece of cake! Spam 777" in the chat for me!"
